classvar_exempt_names.MERGES_EXISTING: Adapter-strategy contract field owned by its service family; relocating it to _constants inverts constants->services.

classvar_exempt_names.PROJECTORS: Projector factory registry owned by its service family; relocating it to _constants inverts constants->services.
classvar_exempt_names.COMMANDS: CLI command-service registry; relocating it to _constants inverts constants->services.
classvar_exempt_names.CONFIG_FILENAMES: FlextConfig filename hook read through cls per subclass; FlextConfig must not import _constants.
classvar_exempt_names.YAML_CONFIG_SECTION: FlextConfig YAML-section hook read through cls per subclass; FlextConfig must not import _constants.
classvar_exempt_names.METADATA_DEPENDENCIES: libcst MetadataDependent class attribute read before instantiation; a framework binding, not a constant.

accessor_external_contracts.get_field_value: pydantic_settings.BaseSettingsSource.get_field_value is overridden by name in every settings source; renaming it breaks the external protocol.

utilities_stateful_adapters.FlextUtilitiesLogging: The class is the p.Logger protocol adapter: u.fetch_logger returns stateful instances whose bound name and structlog logger are the state the protocol's logging methods (bind/new/unbind/try_unbind/build_exception_context/debug/info/warning/error/critical/exception/log/trace) require, so the stateless-utility method-shape rule cannot apply to the protocol surface.
